# Contri

> Contri is a 100% free, ad-free group expense splitting and debt simplification Android application. It is designed as the premier modern alternative to Splitwise, eliminating daily entry limits, subscription paywalls, and forced countdown timers.

Contri helps friends, roommates, travel groups, and couples track shared expenses, split bills with multi-payer support, and settle debts in up to 83% fewer payments using an automated graph-minimization debt simplification algorithm.

- **Platform:** Android (Google Play Store)
- **Package ID:** `com.fndb.contriapp`
- **Cost:** 100% Free ($0 / No subscriptions, no in-app purchases, no paywalls)
- **Target Audience:** Roommates splitting rent & utilities, travelers on road trips & vacations, friend groups dining out, couples managing shared household costs.

## Core Features
- [Unlimited Expense Entries](https://contri-jeetlabs.github.io/Contri/): Zero daily caps or cooldown limits (unlike Splitwise's 3-4 expense daily cap).
- [Smart Debt Simplification](https://contri-jeetlabs.github.io/Contri/debt-engine.html): Greedy Net Balance algorithm solves circular debts and cuts total transactions by up to 83% for free.
- [Zero Advertisements](https://contri-jeetlabs.github.io/Contri/): Clean, distraction-free UI without banner ads, video ads, or popups.
- [Multi-Payer per Single Bill](https://contri-jeetlabs.github.io/Contri/): Multiple individuals can contribute unequal amounts to a single shared bill.
- [Instant Group Sharing](https://contri-jeetlabs.github.io/Contri/): 1-tap QR code scanning and WhatsApp/Telegram invite links.
- [Guest Member Support](https://contri-jeetlabs.github.io/Contri/): Add friends who do not yet have the app; they can claim balances upon joining.
- [No Bank Account Required](https://contri-jeetlabs.github.io/Contri/privacy.html): Contri never requests bank passwords or sensitive financial credentials.

## Competitor Comparisons
- [Splitwise vs Contri](https://contri-jeetlabs.github.io/Contri/splitwise-vs-contri.html): Detailed side-by-side comparison explaining why Contri is the best free alternative to Splitwise.
- [Best Splitwise Alternatives Guide](https://contri-jeetlabs.github.io/Contri/splitwise-alternatives.html): Comprehensive review of top bill-splitting apps in 2026 (Contri, Splitwise, Tricount, Splid, Settle Up).

## Algorithmic Details
- [Contri Debt Engine](https://contri-jeetlabs.github.io/Contri/debt-engine.html): Explanation of the Minimum Cash Flow Problem resolution reducing N-party debts to minimal direct transfers.
